verdict.rationale: Publishing operating hours, per-day limits, or session timeouts for an online filing flow is a fair question for an IP office's e-filing service, so the axis applies. None of the evidence items (filing-page titles for trademarks, patents, designs, e-Soleau, and general site blurbs) mention service hours, daily submission caps, or session timeouts. The data.inpi.fr 403 probe concerns API token access, not disclosure of online-flow limits.
